notes.title: Patch Build V1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Bugs Fixing:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] I have fixed travel between maps in multiplayer. The clients are disconnected and only the host was traveling
[/olist]

[h3]Update and improvements:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The configuration options (Sound Graphic, Game Difficulty) are recorded. There is no longer a need to reconfigure everything every time the game is restarted.
[*] 
[*] The difficulty options have been separated from the rest of the options and are only accessible from the main menu and not from the game pause.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 5.0.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now the Game is faster and takes up less disk and memory
[*]clean code. 
[*]Remove content legacy
[*] Polish Procedural content Generation...Now the every level is always diferent. If you replay level 1 the props is completely procedural.
[/list]

[h3]Corrections:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balancing Game. Projectil Damage is increased but elites and bosses has endurance 
[*]  Radius Damage and damange for grenade and Rocket Launcher Is increased. Next to Explosion Radius Is posible kill all of the normal enemies even elites.
[*]  Dodge Time Cooldown  is lowerer, now you can dodge more frequently.
[*]  Dodge Distance is shorter
[*]  Grenade Time Cooldown is lower, You can Launch grenade more frequently.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Rocked launcher ability. Now you can buy only in last level and unequip weapon when time expires
[*]Fixed Particles Explosives (Grenade and Rocket Launcher)

[/list]

There's an issue with the creating sessions... I Hope resolve before release but in the other case,  the Coop online mode it should launch in DLC or in an  update

notes.title: Patch 4.0.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
The Videogame improves the performance.
Lights
UI more clear and intuitive.
Characters (Players and Enemies): Animations smoth and enemies IA´s: Boss and FinalBoss with diferent Behavior.
Weapons, Projectiles, and FX.
HealthCompents 
and more improve Performance in general gameplay
 

[h3]bugs and Corrections[/h3]
I am having technical difficulties implementing the creation of sessions in multiplayer, so for now I have had to remove that feature, although it may be added in the future.

The game has been oriented towards single-player, 5 additional maps have been added to single-player mode.  The lore of the game is in the community hub as well as a guide to it.

notes.title: Patch 3.0.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 5 Levels have been added in single player mode, I hope you enjoy them

[*] Changes to the AI ​​of Crawling enemies. They behave in Horde mode and in a suicidal way,
[*] walkers are smarter.

[*] Improved Damage System. The damage zones are now attached to the arms, which will cause damage with the attack.

[/list]

[h3]Issues:[/h3]
Some users have experienced problems creating Sessions through Steam over the internet. This is a common problem that sometimes appears with the latest versions of Unreal (5.2) and Steam. If the problem persists I will use the Epic EOS system, I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
Needless to say, the game works perfectly over LAN or over VPN (example HAMACHI)

[h3]Next Patch:[/h3]

[h2]Bosses at levels 3 and 5[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Level 1.- tutorial
 [*] Level 2.- Crawling Demons
[*] Level 3.- Greater Crawling Demon (Boss)
[*] Level 4.- Lesser walking demons
[*] Level 5.- Greater Demons of Walkers

[/olist]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.5
notes.notes:
In the previous update there were two annoying bugs that I fixed as I went along;
-The quick access menu for purchasing lower skills was out of control. Now you can shop with quick access buttons.
-Fixed some errors that appeared in Multiplayer: Skill Purchases.

Sound has been added to the character's actions:
-Pain
-Death
-Grenade Throw
-Dodge.
-Disruption of Grenade throw and dodge


Experience improvement:
-Speed ​​and Heal Skill have a minor cooldown. They recover sooner.
-Improved artificial intelligence of demons. Now the demons patrol randomly, And they chase you if they see or hear you. and they stop doing it within 10 seconds of hearing or seeing you. and return to the random patrol state.
-Improved spawn system Now they do not fall but are generated at a random point visible through the particle system.

notes.title: Patch 2.0.4
notes.notes:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed debug message for multiplayer
[*] Improve Dass/Dodge:  Now the distance is decreased and cooldown timer is increased  a bit.
[*] The Dass/Dodge cooldown timer has more contrast to show better when the skill is avavible
[*] The grenade has full damage, no has fall damage. 
[*] Added Pain voice to Player Hit animations
[*] Added blood particles and sound to some enemy attack animations: Some Demon Attack animations for both walkers and crawlers were missing sound and blood.
[*] Map1  for multiplayer and for Fly solo is improved. 
[*] Map 2 for multiplayer is improved  
[/list]

[h3]bugs and Corrections[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed player HUD. How to access the skill and character stores was poorly indicated.
[*] Fixed  Swap Character in Fly solo.
[*] Errors that occurred in the UI have been corrected. When you pressed pause, or the player died or the character changed, sometimes the controller was lost, you had to use the mouse.
[*] A very annoying bug has been corrected: in the quick access interface to skills, the new skills of the newly purchased character were not loaded.
[/list]



[h3]Thanks to feedback from the community, these errors have been corrected:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The grenade and the launcher had no sound. Now they have sound
[*] The user HUD had a confusing error. "objective" has been replaced by "goal"
[*] The graphic options menu also had errors. They have been fixed.
[*] I have left the stick to aim and the right trigger to shoot
[*] This way you aim better with the grenade and the corner. It has been suggested to me on a couple of occasions.
[/list]

We are aware that some bugs are still present, such as sometimes demons get trapped inside the environment.

Please if you see any any annoying bug, let me know so I can correct it as soon as possible.
